title: Ministry of Culture and Arts — measured pilot

ownership.note: Exact www host linked by Foreign Affairs; trusted redirect and rendered identity corroborated. No endorsement of this evaluation is implied.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, three attempts per each of three predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: An initial normal-browser follow-up returned local filtering interstitials. Those documents were excluded and retained privately. A normal Chrome UA follow-up rendered all three ministry pages; original failed observations are not scored as ministry failures.

The guarded observation excluded numerous subresources. Independent normal-browser checks confirmed the 415px narrow-screen overflow and the language-link contrast defect; absence of automated axe violations is not used as proof of conformity.

Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 0 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 0 assessed budget points. 3/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 24 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 0 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

findings.title: Reduce mobile loading cost
findings.detail: The mobile homepage LCP median was 33.30 seconds, range 26.02–33.54 seconds across three successful simulated runs. Inspect render-critical resources; this operator-network sample is not field p75 or a fixed experience for every visitor.

findings.title: Remove the narrow-screen width constraint
findings.detail: The normal-browser document width was 415px at both 320px and 390px on all three reviewed pages. Adjust the shared layout so content fits without horizontal scrolling.

findings.title: Improve the language link contrast and image alternatives
findings.detail: The Français control measured 2.29:1 against white at 14px. Replace generic numeric/banner alternatives with useful descriptions and remove the leaked slider promotion text.

findings.title: Add semantic landmarks and response policies
findings.detail: The reviewed DOMs lacked main/navigation landmarks. HSTS and enforced CSP were absent from the three response captures, and cookie flags were mixed.

privacy.reason: A personal-data-processing heading was observed in the page DOM; the applicable notice and consent states were not fully reviewed.
Trusted HTTPS delivery was observed, but no personal data or submissions were sent.
No complete third-party inventory classification or consent-state audit was performed.
A complete retention policy and actionable rights workflow were not established.
General institutional contacts do not establish a dedicated privacy-rights channel.
Equivalent privacy explanations across the offered languages were not reviewed.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The captured HTTP entry upgraded to HTTPS, without a downgrade, and reached the declared ministry homepage. This is the observed entry chain, not every URL variant.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: All three declared core pages returned successful trusted HTTPS responses with normal hostname, chain and validity verification. One negotiated TLS connection does not establish the full protocol/cipher configuration.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Strict-Transport-Security was absent from all three captured ministry page responses. HTTPS redirects do not establish an HSTS policy.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: Enforced Content-Security-Policy response headers were absent from the three captures; no CSP meta policy appeared in the successfully guarded page DOMs. These sampled pages do not establish an enforced CSP.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and Referrer-Policy: origin-when-cross-origin were consistently observed on all three declared pages.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: The observed cookie set mixed a Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict cookie with another lacking Secure and explicit SameSite. Partial credit; no names or values are published.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: The public generator identifies Joomla without an explicit deployed version in that value. Product-family disclosure receives partial credit; support status was not determined.

rows.label: No obvious sensitive configuration exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Passive eligible-page review only; no guessed sensitive paths. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Third-party tracking and technical privacy restraint
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Request inventory plus tracking classification. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Largest Contentful Paint
rows.reason: Worst median lab LCP 33299 ms. Full/half thresholds 2500/4000 ms. This is a simulated lab sample, not field p75.

rows.label: Responsiveness
rows.reason: Worst median lab TBT 114 ms; full/half thresholds 200/600 ms. TBT is explicitly a proxy: field INP was not measured.

rows.label: Cumulative Layout Shift
rows.reason: Worst median lab CLS 0.0359; full/half thresholds 0.1/0.25. Post-load citizen flows and field CLS were not measured.

rows.label: Server response and first content
rows.reason: Worst median FCP 12520 ms; document server-response audit 141 ms. Full limits 1800/800 ms; half 3000/1800 ms. The response audit excludes connection/redirect time.

rows.label: Resource and page-weight efficiency
rows.reason: Worst median transfer 5836716 bytes; request count 95. Full limits 2 MB/80 requests; half 4 MB/150 requests, decimal MB.

rows.label: Performance consistency
rows.reason: Largest repeated within-page/device LCP max/min ratio 1.29; full/half thresholds 1.5/2. Operator network and this session only.

rows.label: Verified WCAG 2.2 issue set
rows.reason: The guarded automated sample reported no A/AA violations, but the independent normal-browser check confirmed a low-contrast language link. This localized manually confirmed failure prevents full credit; clean automated results are not a conformance certification.

rows.label: Color contrast
rows.reason: The Français language link uses rgb(114,190,68) on a solid white ancestor background at 14px normal weight. Independent computed-style review and sRGB calculation gave 2.29:1, below 4.5:1. This is interface text, not a logotype. Partial credit for a localized defect.

rows.label: Image alternative text
rows.reason: Many important homepage images have descriptive alternatives, but the captured gallery/banner inventory also uses generic numeric/name alternatives such as 37, amir and 1–4 for distinct visual content. Meaningful alternative text is therefore only partially supported; decorative images are not automatically penalized.

rows.label: Form labels, instructions and errors
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual form inspection plus axe. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Keyboard navigation
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual keyboard path notes. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Semantic HTML and headings
rows.reason: The captured pages lack main/navigation landmarks. The homepage has no H1/H2 structure, while the history page has section headings. Partial semantic-structure credit is limited to these DOMs.

rows.label: Focus indicators
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual interaction notes. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.reason: Declared discovery task: find the artist-card/remote-service portal entry and the institutional contact route. Service entries were visible; the contact directory led to a readable address/telephone/reception-hours page. Narrow-screen overflow and untested external applications limit this to partial pre-service discovery credit.

rows.label: Interface consistency
rows.reason: The three normal-browser page types shared the ministry header, navigation and visual system. Local reflow or accessible-name defects are documented in their own rows.

rows.label: Errors, recovery and contextual help
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Journey and form notes. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Official identity and domain ownership clear
rows.reason: The Foreign Affairs ministry directory independently links the exact www host. The captured trusted redirect and rendered ministry identity corroborate domain association; this is not government endorsement of the research.

rows.label: Ministry mission and organization available
rows.reason: The ministry-history page supplies a timeline of organizational structures with decree references. The supplementary contact page identifies current department contact routes, but a complete current remit was not reviewed.

rows.label: Public services clearly listed
rows.reason: The homepage explicitly lists artist-card, book, association-support and remote-service portal entry points. These external portals were not opened or evaluated.

rows.label: Procedures and eligibility explained
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Procedure pages or documents. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Required documents, forms and instructions available
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Forms, PDFs and instructions. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Service links/forms functional
rows.reason: The core ministry pages and the observed contact-detail destination rendered; a benign search returned results. External artist-card/support portals were not opened or submitted, so service-function credit remains partial.

rows.label: Contact or feedback channel available
rows.reason: The actual ministry-address link from the contact directory was opened. Its destination displayed postal address, telephone, reception hours and institutional email routes. No messages or calls were made.

rows.label: Useful multilingual content where applicable
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Arabic, French, Tamazight and English review. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Publication and update dates available
rows.reason: The benign search results show article creation dates; the sampled institutional/contact guidance lacks consistent update dates. The 2016 copyright is not treated as a content-update date.

rows.label: Content clarity and cross-page consistency
rows.reason: Arabic service names and institutional contact details are readable, but the homepage exposes a literal DJ-ImageSlider module/promotion string in another language. Generic banner/image alternatives also reduce clarity; this is sample-bounded presentation review.

rows.label: No significant broken internal links
rows.reason: The three declared core destinations returned HTTP 200 and their content rendered in normal-browser follow-up. A supplementary benign search also returned results. This is a bounded observed-link sample, not an exhaustive crawl or external-service guarantee.

rows.label: No broken images/resources
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Observed browser response failures. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Meaningful page titles and metadata
rows.reason: The three pages have subject-specific Arabic titles, but their descriptions repeat the generic ministry description. Partial sampled metadata credit.

rows.label: Sitemap/crawlability configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: robots.txt and sitemap.xml observations. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Clean URLs, canonicalization and redirects
rows.reason: HTTP upgrades to HTTPS and the Arabic homepage. No rel=canonical appeared in the three guarded core DOMs, preventing full combined URL/canonicalization credit.

rows.label: Functional site search and discoverability
rows.reason: A benign query, built from the actual observed GET search action and input names, returned relevant ministry result titles and pagination. The complete search-control keyboard/empty-state workflow was not exercised, so this query/result-route check receives partial credit.

rows.label: No critically outdated public technology
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Passive fingerprint plus verified support status. An untested step or constrained capture is not counted as a pass or failure.

rows.label: Cross-page technical consistency
rows.reason: All three normal-browser follow-up pages rendered with shared ministry identity, navigation and visual conventions. Credit is bounded to this sample, not all browsers or pages.
